question: What is SEP-41 and how does it relate to the Stellar Asset Contract?

golden.answer: SEP-41 is the Draft Soroban Token Interface: the common fungible-token functions (balance, transfer, approve and allowance, burn, metadata) that custom token contracts implement. It is a subset of the Stellar Asset Contract interface in CAP-46-6, so the SAC implements it and adds admin functions. As of 2026-11-14 it is v0.5.2, and signatures changed between drafts, so version-qualify code.
keyFacts: SEP-41 is the Draft Soroban Token Interface for fungible tokens.
Custom token contracts implement the SEP-41 interface.
SEP-41 is a subset of the CAP-46-6 SAC interface, so the SAC implements it.
SEP-41 signatures changed between Draft versions; a cited version carries its date.
avoid: Do NOT claim that SAC admin functions such as mint and clawback are required generic SEP-41 methods.
golden.notes: Do not penalize v0.5.0 or v0.5.1 when dated to an earlier observation; accept a later dated version.
